FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you handle legal advertising rules?

We work within the ethical rules for your jurisdiction, and your compliance counsel reviews disclaimers and case result presentation before launch.

Is the intake form secure?

Yes. Submissions are encrypted and access is restricted, with routing that supports your conflict check process.

Do you write legal content?

We draft from your attorneys’ expertise and submit everything for their review. Legal content is never published without your approval.

How long does a law firm site take?

Usually eight to twelve weeks, with content depth and review cycles driving most of the timeline.
